coverage_rule: a dimension is flagged low when either side has under 60% of its expected players

reported_only_attributes.IBL: impact blocking applies to run and pass, so it is not forced into either index
reported_only_attributes.TAC: historical label, not THA: never merged into a Gridiron rating
reported_only_attributes.TAS/TAM/TAD: used per depth in the QB profile, not averaged into one accuracy score
reported_only_attributes.SRR/MRR/DRR: route-running depths are kept separate inside the REC composite
